title: Aksupack Addon Edition
description: Aksupack is a half-simplistic resource pack. Now it's a addon...
body:
# **AKSUPACK Addon Edition**

## About this pack

Aksupack is a half-simplistic resource pack, but this addon is for Minecraft Java Edition Version 1.21.x. 

Aksupack Addon Edition is an addon for Programmer Art and other resource packs. The recommended resource pack to use with this addon is Golden Days with Programmer Art.

Aksupack status is still "fulfilled", this does not mean "abandoning" this project.

The Pack may receive updates from time to time.

First version of this pack was released in PMC, Feb 4th, 2012.
